Share net worth desktop. SUPERSEDED by 13008-30018/51352/45556 under the 2026-09-04 ruling and not to be implemented. ★ THIS ROW IS DELIBERATELY NOT PROMOTED, AND THAT IS THE FINDING. Its status row has claimed `done` since wave 55; coverage.mjs:595-598 pulls it back because only a vverify verdict of `match` lets a `done` claim stand, and this frame's verdict is `partial`. Writing `match` was considered and REFUSED: vverify.wallet.tsv:76 records that wave 55 demoted this family FROM a bare `match` precisely because ShareCard.tsx draws the 13008 family, not this one — they share no geometry, so `match` would re-commit the exact stale-claim defect wave 55 fixed. A frame Casey ruled must NEVER be implemented has no verdict that closes it: `match` is false, `partial`/`deferred` hold it open forever, `not-wired` is worse. The 2026-09-20 ruling that such a row counts DONE is currently inexpressible. Five waves have opened this frame and none has closed it. Needs a fifth verdict or a tally exemption; escalated to the orchestrator, not a lane call. No edit made or owed.

768 home, skin 3 (hidden balance). Not re-read; wave 55 read it live whole and its container 8379:79350 is the same 580x713 at (94,76) on the same four offsets, a third independent witness. Skin 3 is wired end to end without a prop and that wiring is this lane's and verified. THE OPEN ITEM IS A CASEY CALL, unchanged and restated rather than re-decided: the board masks only the headline and the 24h change (Frame 289 91 wide with a 61x28 asterisk run and the eye at x=67; Frame 332 58 wide with two runs, 24 then 30) and leaves the three token rows in PLAIN figures — $115.83/1.10 SOL, $100.17/233.13 LINK, $74.01/1.6M PEPE — where the build masks the rows too (TokenListTable.tsx:640, :654). The setting reads "Show or hide your balance from public view", and rows printing exact holdings under a hidden headline defeat it, so the build is arguably right and the board wrong. Casey's to rule; TokenListTable.tsx is outside this fence either way. No edit made.

The 168 is 70 + 20 + 44 + 20 + 14 and each term was checked: field block 70 (label 14 + gap 8 + field 48), CTA 44, link 14 at Sm/Paragraph 2 12/14. Lockup 87x36 at (144,286) — (375-87)/2 = 144. Form 328 on the 24 inset; 375-328 = 47 does not halve, which is why WalletUnlock.tsx:196 carries the extra pixel on the form rather than the column, keeping the lockup centred at x=144. Unlock phone, password filled — 375x812. ★ THE "WHICH TWIN GOVERNS" QUESTION IS CLOSED THIS PASS BY ARITHMETIC, and it was never a stroke or a coordinate space. Read live: get_design_context on the inputs frame 7727:14976. Its three children are input/primary-inputs h=70, CTA h=44 and the link 7727:14981, on a declared gap-[20px] column: 70+20+44+20+16 = 170, which is the board's reported 328x170. The empty twin's 168 is the same sum with a 14 box. SO THE ENTIRE 2px IS THE LINK'S TYPE STEP — Sm/Paragraph 1 14/16 here against Sm/Paragraph 2 12/14 on 7727-14937 — and the y follows from it, not from a stroke: block 242 against 240, both centred on 406, so the taller board starts 1px higher (285 vs 286). The x 23-vs-24 is one centred box rounding opposite ways, since 375-328 = 47. A link does not grow when the first character is typed, so the empty board governs and the shipped 12/14 stands; the disagreement is a BOARD DEFECT, recorded not built to. Also verified against this board and already correct at HEAD: the field's 1.5px #17F9B4 focus border and its 48 box (16+16+16, the EQUAL case, paid as box-border h-[48px] in UnlockForm.tsx:99-102). Welcome phone, get-the-app new user — 375x812. The foreground block is verified and carries a `match` line at vverify.wallet.tsv:286 scoped to it. Re-derived this pass: the shipped block is 36 lockup + 36 clear + 44 + 20 + 44 + 20 + 28 notice = 228, half 114, which is WalletShellWelcome.tsx:97 `pt-[calc(50vh-114px)]`. It is deliberately SHORTER than the board's 180 block (lockup 316..352, CTAs 328x108 at (24,388)) because the thirdweb-only ruling of 2026-07-03 moves the email form one step in and the consent notice lands under the column — a centring offset is a hand-computed half of the block and has to be re-derived whenever the block grows, which is done and correct. The 87x36 lockup landed in fa1390b and the wave-41 bare `match` it overturned (skai-ui's `small` short preset is 58x24, skai-logo.tsx:289/:362) is confirmed: the box is set at the call site and the SVG fills it, 87 = 36 x 116/48 so nothing stretches. Home PHONE — 375x812, NOT the 768x1024 the catalog title claims. ★ THE TITLE CANNOT BE CORRECTED IN THE CATALOG AND THAT OVERTURNS THIS LANE'S OWN INSTRUCTION. The brief said to fix the title as I touched the row; I checked before editing and did not. wallet.titles.tsv is harvest-generated from the Figma LAYER NAME (harvest.mjs:641 writes `${hyphen(r.id)}\t${r.name}`), and harvest.mjs:549-551 records that a hand-written title survives only for a NESTED id — a top-level board's title is written back over, and "four such titles were lost on 2026-09-09". This is a top-level board, so a hand edit would be silently reverted at the next harvest and would meanwhile make the catalog disagree with Figma. The mislabel is in the Figma frame name and design has to rename the board; recorded here instead. Geometry (wave 57, live): Header-mobile 375x48, Main 346x704 at (15,64), four children 8 apart at 0/56/286/464. (375-346)/2 = 14.5 -> 15 and 48+16 = 64; the column computes 345 from px-[15px] and the 346 is the box sitting one off centre, per shell/layout.ts. Streak COLLAPSED here (48) against 92 on the twin. HELD PARTIAL for QuickActionsBar.tsx, NetWorthCard.tsx and TokenListTable.tsx. No edit made.

HELD PARTIAL for that file and its two siblings. No edit made.
